map.浇水间隔按季节、天气与盆土类型调整：生长期（春秋）一般 2 至 5 天、夏季 1: Watering interval adjusts by season, weather and soil type: in the growing season (spring and autumn) generally 2 to 5 days, 1 to 2 days in summer, 7 to 15 days in winter; water-retention corrections for soil are × 0.8 for porous peat mix, × 1.0 for garden soil, × 0.6 for sandy soil; delay 1 to 2 days on overcast or rainy days and bring forward 1 day in hot dry weather; the criterion is water when dry on the surface, watering thoroughly once the top 2-3 cm is dry, using water running out of the pot base as the sign of thorough watering.

map.季节/环境动态调整: Dynamic adjustment by season and environment
map.依植物基础频率×季节系数×环境系数得调整后天数；喜湿类（绿萝/月季）频、耐旱类（: Adjusted days = plant base frequency × season factor × environment factor; moisture lovers (pothos / rose) are watered often, drought tolerant types (snake plant / succulent) rarely; the summer factor is 0.6 (frequent) and winter 1.8 (restricted).
map.绿萝、20cm 盆、夏季阳台：基础 5 天×0.6×1.0≈3 天一次，单次约: Pothos, 20cm pot, summer balcony: base 5 days×0.6×1.0≈every 3 days, about 240ml each time, about 10 times a month, about 2.4L of water per month; the same pot in winter indoors gives 5×1.8×1.3≈every 12 days and about 234ml each time, a clear reduction in frequency.
map.频率推荐能照做吗？: Can I follow the frequency recommendation as is?
map.仅作起点，仍需摸盆土（竹签插入拔出不湿即浇）；通风、光照、盆土差异大，按实际微调: It is only a starting point; you still need to feel the soil (insert a chopstick and pull it out — water if it is not damp). Ventilation, light and soil vary a lot, so fine-tune by actual conditions.
map.为什么夏季反而要勤浇？: Why does summer need more frequent watering?
map.高温蒸发快、盆土易干，但正午忌浇冷水；早晚浇、叶面喷水增湿更安全。: High temperature makes evaporation fast and the soil dry out easily, but avoid cold water at midday; watering in the morning and evening plus leaf misting is safer.
